newsitem.title: INDIA: India to sell 20 bln rupees of 7-yr securities.
newsitem.headline: India to sell 20 bln rupees of 7-yr securities.

text.p: The Indian government said on Tuesday that the Reserve Bank of India will sell 20 billion rupees' worth of seven-year dated securities on June 17.
The government said in a statement that the government stock is eligible for the ready-forward facility.
The Reserve Bank of India will auction the seven-year securities on June 17 and the payment by successful bidders will be made on June 18. -- New Delhi newsroom +91-11 301 2024
